name: Fairmont Mayakoba

address.street: Carretera Federal Cancún Playa del Carmen Km 298

insider_take: Where cenotes meet Caribbean luxury in Mexico's most exclusive eco-resort enclave.
whats_special: Set within a 240-hectare nature preserve, this sustainable paradise features overwater bungalows accessible only by boat, plus a unique cenote spa experience in a natural limestone cave. The resort operates entirely on renewable energy and was built around existing mangroves without disturbing the ecosystem.
pro_tip: Book the Cenote Spa's signature "Journey to the Underworld" treatment – you'll be one of the few people on Earth to experience a massage in an actual Mayan sacred cenote cave system.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary boat ride through the mangrove channels at sunset, and visit the nearby Rosewood's beach club via the resort's exclusive golf cart shuttle – it's like having access to multiple luxury properties in one stay.
pros: Stunning lagoon and cenote setting with direct water access
Exceptional spa featuring traditional Mayan treatments
Multiple world-class dining venues with diverse cuisines
Championship golf course and comprehensive recreational facilities
